tool_schemas.name: getFileContents
tool_schemas.description: Returns the contents and metadata for a single file at `path` in the connected vault repository, read from `ref` (or the repo’s default branch when omitted), optionally re-fetching from GitHub and updating the cache when `refresh_cache` is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `vault_repo_id` or `path` is missing/invalid, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the vault connection or the GitHub credentials no longer authorize the repo, NOT_FOUND if the vault connection does not exist, the ref cannot be resolved, or the file does not exist at that ref, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when a cache refresh would exceed configured GitHub or service limits. Raises CONFLICT if a refresh is requested while the vault repo is in a state that forbids syncing (e.g., credentials revoked/disabled or another sync is already in progress for the same resource).

vault_repo_id.description: ID of the vault repository connection (obgh_vlt_...).

ref.description: Git ref to read from (branch name, tag, or commit SHA). If omitted, uses the vault repo default branch.

refresh_cache.description: If true, re-fetch from GitHub and update the cached file before returning.

tool_schemas.name: searchFiles
tool_schemas.description: Searches cached repository files for the given `query`, with optional branch, path, extension, and deleted-file filters, and returns a paged list of matching file records sorted by `sort`/`order` and limited by `limit`; when more results exist, the response includes a `cursor` that you pass back to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters (including unsupported sort/order, invalid `limit`, or malformed cursor), AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the vault connection, NOT_FOUND if `vault_repo_id` does not exist (and, when `branch` is provided, if it cannot be resolved), and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when `refresh_cache` is true and the refresh would exceed GitHub or service limits. Raises CONFLICT when a refresh is requested but the vault repo cannot be refreshed at that time (for example due to disabled credentials or an in-progress sync).

vault_repo_id.description: ID of the vault repository connection (obgh_vlt_...).

query.description: Search query (supports GitHub-style search syntax across filename/path/content).

branch.description: Limit search to a specific branch. If omitted, uses the vault repo default branch.

path_prefix.description: Limit results to files whose path starts with this prefix (e.g., "Notes/").

extensions.description: Limit results to files with these extensions (e.g., ["md","canvas"]).

include_deleted.description: Whether to include files marked deleted in the cache.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

refresh_cache.description: If true, refresh relevant cached file index from GitHub before searching.

tool_schemas.name: searchIssues
tool_schemas.description: Searches cached issues and/or discussions in the connected vault repository using `query` and optional filters (type, state, labels, author), returning a paged list of items sorted by `sort`/`order` up to `limit`; if additional matches exist, the response includes an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enums, invalid `limit`, or malformed cursor, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the vault connection or GitHub access is not permitted, NOT_FOUND if the vault connection does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when `refresh_cache` is true and the refresh would exceed configured limits. Raises CONFLICT when a refresh is requested while issue/discussion syncing is not allowed or already running for the same vault repo.

vault_repo_id.description: ID of the vault repository connection (obgh_vlt_...).

query.description: Search query for issues/discussions (supports GitHub-style qualifiers like is:issue, is:discussion, author:, label:, state:).

type.description: Whether to search issues, discussions, or both.

labels.description: Filter to items containing all specified labels.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

refresh_cache.description: If true, refresh cached issues/discussions from GitHub before searching.

tool_schemas.name: getCommitHistory
tool_schemas.description: Lists commits for the connected vault repository (optionally scoped to a `path`, `ref`, time window, or `author_login`) and returns a paged commit feed sorted by committed time with optional cached patch details when `include_patches` is true; results are limited by `limit` and continued with the returned `cursor` when more commits are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid timestamps, invalid `limit`, unsupported sort/order, or malformed cursor, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the vault connection or the configured GitHub credentials cannot read commit history, NOT_FOUND if the vault connection does not exist or the requested `ref`/`path` cannot be resolved, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when `refresh_cache` is true and fetching updated history would exceed limits. Raises CONFLICT when a refresh is requested but commit syncing is currently blocked (for example due to disabled credentials or an in-progress sync).

vault_repo_id.description: ID of the vault repository connection (obgh_vlt_...).

path.description: Optional file path to filter commits affecting a specific file.

ref.description: Git ref to list history from (branch name or commit SHA). If omitted, uses the vault repo default branch.

since.description: Only include commits after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

until.description: Only include commits up to this timestamp (ISO 8601).

author_login.description: Filter commits by author GitHub login.

include_patches.description: If true, include cached patch/diff details when available.

limit.description: Maximum number of commits to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

refresh_cache.description: If true, refresh cached commit activity from GitHub before returning history.

tool_schemas.name: getAuthContext
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity for the presented API key, including the resolved workspace, effective scopes/permissions, and current rate-limit/quota consumption for this key. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the API key is missing, revoked, or the workspace is deleted (and, by default policy, suspended workspaces).

api_key.description: API key secret presented by the caller (obgh_key_...). If omitted, the server uses the credential presented via the standard Authorization mechanism.

tool_schemas.name: listVaultRepos
tool_schemas.description: Lists vault repository connections visible to the caller within the workspace, with optional status/visibility filtering and cursor pagination. Returns a paged list of `vault_repos` records. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the API key is invalid/revoked or the workspace is not accessible.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to list vault repos for (obgh_wsp_...). If omitted, uses the workspace implied by the API key.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: createVaultRepo
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new vault repository connection for a workspace and stores an authentication reference used for GitHub sync and on-demand refresh. Returns the created `vault_repos` record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid owner/repo/branch/auth fields, CONFLICT_ERROR if the same owner/repo is already connected in the workspace, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot create vault connections.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to create the vault repo under (obgh_wsp_...). If omitted, uses the workspace implied by the API key.

default_branch.description: Default branch to use when `ref`/`branch` is omitted (e.g., "main").

visibility.description: Repository visibility as known to GitHub.

auth_ref.description: Reference to stored credentials (e.g., secret id, connection id). The server never returns the underlying secret.

set_as_default.description: If true, configures this vault as the deterministic default vault for the workspace when one is required.

tool_schemas.name: updateVaultRepo
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing vault repository connection (e.g., default branch, auth reference, or enabling/disabling). Returns the updated `vault_repos` record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid updates, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot modify the vault connection, and CONFLICT_ERROR when the update would violate uniqueness constraints.

vault_repo_id.description: ID of the vault repository connection (obgh_vlt_...).

default_branch.description: New default branch for this vault repo.

auth_type.description: New authentication type for GitHub access.

auth_ref.description: New reference to stored credentials for GitHub access.

status.description: Set the vault repo status. Use "disabled" to prevent sync/refresh; use "active" to re-enable. Other states are server-managed.

tool_schemas.name: syncVaultRepo
tool_schemas.description: Triggers a GitHub sync for the vault repository connection, fetching/upserting files, commits, and issues/discussions into the cache and advancing `last_sync_at`/`last_sync_commit_sha` when successful. Returns a sync receipt including the resulting vault status. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the caller cannot sync, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid options, and CONFLICT_ERROR when a sync is already in progress.

vault_repo_id.description: ID of the vault repository connection (obgh_vlt_...).

mode.description: Sync mode. "incremental" syncs from the last known commit when available; "full" rebuilds caches for the selected ref(s).

ref.description: Git ref to sync (branch name, tag, or commit SHA). If omitted, uses the vault repo default branch.

include.description: Which datasets to sync. When omitted, all are synced.

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. When provided, only changes since this time are fetched where supported by GitHub APIs.

force.description: If true, forces a sync attempt even when the vault is in status="error"; still refused when status="disabled".

tool_schemas.name: getVaultRepo
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single vault repository connection by id and returns the `vault_repos` record, including its current status and last sync metadata. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the caller cannot access the vault connection or the workspace is not accessible.

vault_repo_id.description: ID of the vault repository connection (obgh_vlt_...).

metadata.name: Obsidian GitHub
metadata.description: This backend stores connections to GitHub repositories that represent Obsidian vaults, plus cached copies of files, commits, and issues/discussions to support fast search and history retrieval. Main workflows are: register a vault repo + credentials, periodically sync files/commits/issues from GitHu
